_note: The client's three ACTUAL products, extracted from the brief's reference photos. Real-world dimensions are DOCUMENTED ASSUMPTIONS used as scale anchors for the compositor (see design.md 'Scale estimation'). 'placement_style' encodes how each product is actually styled in its own reference photo, so the compositor arranges it the way the client does – not a generic 'flank the door'.

products.name: Charcoal Cylinder
products.form: broad, low matte-black cylindrical drum with densely mounded mixed foliage
products.planting: lush mixed foliage mounding well above the rim – hosta, fatsia japonica, ornamental grasses, trailing greens, a touch of Japanese maple
products.palette: deep greens, no strong flower colour
products.placement_style: Arrange as a CLUSTER or short ROW of 2–3 identical drums forming a lush, continuous LOW GREEN BORDER along the base of the shopfront window, or grouped to one side framing the entrance. It reads as a planted border, never a single lonely pot. The drums are broad and low with foliage mounding ~50cm above the rim; set them close together so the planting reads as one mass.
products.best_for: lining modern / dark shopfronts and glazed frontages with a low green border; grouping where there is room for 2–3 drums side by side
products.scale_notes: Each drum rim sits at about knee-to-mid-thigh height (~60cm); foliage mounds ~50cm above that. Broad footprint – keep clear of the door swing and the walking line.

products.name: Corten Tiered Set
products.form: tiered weathered-steel set – a tall square column (palm) stepped down to a lower flowering cube, plus a long low trough
products.planting: architectural fan palm in the tall column; ferns and red/pink seasonal flowers in the lower cube and trough
products.palette: rust planter + green palm + hot red/pink flowers
products.typical_quantity: one tiered tall+low grouping, optionally with the separate trough
products.placement_style: Place the tiered tall-column-plus-lower-cube as a single BOLD VERTICAL STATEMENT to ONE side of the entrance, or anchoring a corner – the ~2m palm is the accent. Do NOT place a matching pair of tall palms either side (it looks top-heavy and odd); one strong tiered grouping is the look, with the stepped cube giving height variation. Optionally add the long low trough as a linear planted border along the kerb or terrace/seating edge. Needs a WIDE pavement or a corner for the palm's height and ~1m footprint.
products.best_for: wider frontages and corners; statement entrances; warm brick / stone / painted period facades where a tall vertical accent suits; terrace edges (the trough)
products.scale_notes: Tall column reaches ~waist/elbow height (~105cm); palm crown reaches ~2.1m total. Lower cube ~55cm. Give it clear pavement width; never block the door swing or pedestrian flow.

products.name: White Tapered Pair
products.form: pair of white planters tapering inward toward the base (wider at the top), mounded mixed planting
products.planting: mixed greenery with purple and pink flowering stems mounding above the rim
products.placement_style: Place the TWO tapered planters SIDE BY SIDE as a continuous low planted band, set tight against the shopfront – beneath a window or just to one side of the doorway – with the pavement walking line kept clear in front. Keep them together as a pair, not split to opposite sides.
products.best_for: lighter or painted shopfronts and salons, where the bright white lifts a dark or muted facade; flanking one side of a doorway or sitting under a window as a pair
products.scale_notes: Rim at roughly mid-thigh (~68cm); planting adds ~40cm. Tapered form reads narrower at the base – keep both of the pair at matching scale and close together.
